inputs.name: heating_return_degc
inputs.note: operating return of the built plant (capex fixed); the UQ-CASES DB-31 values are design alternatives (capex re-derived)

inputs.name: warm_climate_frac
inputs.note: [A] fraction of the DB-34b warm-case offset (+5 K dry bulb, +2.6 K wet bulb) added to cooling-season days (cooling demand > 0); one-sided: the base is its P0, not its P50

inputs.name: production_temperature_shift_k
inputs.source: RC-02 item 3 (±6 °C on 30-yr production temperature); spec UQ-01
inputs.note: [A] interpretation: RC-02's Boolean-lens extreme on the 30-yr production temperature (smoother case ±2 °C) applied from year 1 as gradient ± shift/depth (also moves p_b and the DPDT profile)

inputs.name: esp_intake_margin_factor
inputs.note: SUB-PBUB margin = VER-ESP-MARGIN (moved together, TL-05 enforces it); VER-ESP-PB is only the DesignVerifier's fallback (inert in TL-13/15) and is scaled 60 × margin/1.2 so the base is unchanged

inputs.name: injectivity_factor
inputs.source: SUB-II; LIM-SUB-02 (cold injection); WP-11 physics check
inputs.note: [A] II = factor × PI. No card value: 0.8 reproduces LIM-SUB-02's +6 bar on the 26.5 bar(g) injection WHP at 300 m³/h; a near-well cold zone with water viscosity 1.5–1.65 × that at reservoir temperature (55–65 °C injectate) gives ≈ 0.63–0.72, hence 0.65 as the low bound

inputs.name: energy_escalation_real_frac
inputs.source: ECO-REAL: RC-10 energy escalation range minus general inflation
inputs.note: real escalation of energy and CO2 prices
